g1.label: Unitree G1
g1.tagline: Humanoid at the table: picks with either hand, copies you, learns by watching.
examples: Put the mug on the right
Carry the red block over the vase to the left
Let me show you how to stack the blocks
Follow me

panda.label: Franka Panda
panda.tagline: 7-joint arm bolted to the table: precise picks, reaches around obstacles.
examples: Stack the green block on the red block
Put the mug next to the bowl, handle facing me
Line the blocks up along the front edge
Move the cup there without touching the vase

ur5e.label: UR5e
ur5e.tagline: Industrial 6-joint arm: runs the same tasks you taught the humanoid.
examples: Sort the blocks: red on the left, green on the right
Put the can in the box
Move the mug to marker B
Run the skill I taught the G1

xarm7.label: uFactory xArm7
xarm7.tagline: Compact 7-joint arm: short reach, works close to its base.
examples: Put the fruit in the bowl
Bring the cup closer to you
Can you reach the bottle at the back?
Put the block on the bottom shelf

iiwa14.label: KUKA iiwa 14
iiwa14.tagline: Strong collaborative arm: heavier boxes and full bottles.
examples: Move the box to the back of the table
Put the bottle upright in the center, slowly
Stack the plates on the left
Clear the table into the box

aloha.label: ALOHA
aloha.tagline: Two arms facing each other: hand things over, hold with one and work with the other.
examples: Pass the cup from the left arm to the right arm
Hold the bowl with your left arm and put the fruit in with your right
Use your right arm to put the block in the middle
Swap the cup and the can

apollo.label: Apptronik Apollo
apollo.tagline: Full-size humanoid: two-handed carries, high shelves, learns by watching.
examples: Carry the box to the top shelf with both hands
Put the bottle on the shelf at chest height
Let me show you how to pack the box
Copy my arms

stretch3.label: Hello Robot Stretch 3
stretch3.tagline: Slim home robot: drives to a spot, lifts and reaches sideways.
examples: Drive to the counter and bring me the cup
Pick up the can from the floor
Put the mug on the low shelf
Move the fruit from the counter to the table

tidybot.label: Stanford TidyBot
tidybot.tagline: Mobile base with a Kinova arm: drives around and tidies up.
examples: Tidy up: put the cups and bowls on the counter
Pick up the block on the floor and put it in the box
Drive to the shelf and put the bottle on the middle level
Bring the mug to me

spot.label: Spot with arm
spot.tagline: Four legs and a claw arm: walks to the floor or the table and grabs.
examples: Walk to the box and pick up the bottle
Pick up the can on the floor and put it on the table
Bring the bowl to the counter
Follow me

h2.label: Unitree H2
h2.tagline: Full-size humanoid, experimental: whole-body motion and imitation; grasping not yet.
examples: Copy my arms
Learn this wave from my video
Point at the mug
Make the second half of the dance slower
